The Company granted 3,31,154 Employee Stock Options ("ESOPs") on June 29, 2026, comprising 1,29,883 ESOPs granted to the Key Managerial Personnel ("KMPs") of the Company and 2,01,271 ESOPs granted to other eligible employees.
The aforesaid ESOPs are proposed to be implemented through the Company's ESOP Trust. As on the date of this filing, the ESOP Trust holds 48,078 equity shares of the Company acquired through secondary acquisition. Such shareholding has been appropriately disclosed under Category C-2 Employee Benefit Trust under the Non-Promoter Non-Public Shareholding in accordance with the provisions of the SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021.
In accordance with the FAQs issued by the Stock Exchanges on disclosure of ESOPs in the shareholding pattern and for the purpose of appropriately reflecting the fully diluted paid-up equity share capital, the Company has disclosed only the net outstanding ESOPs after adjusting the equity shares already held by the ESOP Trust. Accordingly, the number of outstanding ESOPs disclosed in the shareholding pattern is 2,83,076 (i.e., 3,31,154 ESOPs granted less 48,078 equity shares held by the ESOP Trust).
Of the above, 1,29,883 outstanding ESOPs granted to KMPs have been disclosed against the relevant Public Shareholding category pertaining to the KMPs, while the balance 1,53,193 outstanding ESOPs have been disclosed under the Public Shareholding category "Resident Individuals holding nominal share capital up to Rs.2 lakh."
